meta.title: Move build system to uv
meta.body_summary: Migrate the build system from pip/setuptools to uv, updating build scripts, CI workflows, and documentation for faster dependency resolution and package installation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot build system migration PR; no reviews, comments, or CI feedback, closed within 11 minutes by maintainer without explanation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 49 changed lines across 5 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a quick tooling change, but was closed almost immediately without any engagement, which is inconsistent with a normal small-step perf merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text exists in the dataset; the PR was closed by the assigned reviewer (AsafMah) shortly after creation with no stated reason.
review_details.performance_claim: Faster dependency resolution and package installation using uv instead of pip/setuptools.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by maintainer AsafMah within 11 minutes of creation, with zero review feedback or explanation.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Build system migration PR was closed without any review interaction; agent could not overcome the lack of engagement or demonstrate value through CI or benchmarks.

core_change_summary.description: Changed build_packages.py to call uv build instead of setuptools; added build-system table to pyproject.toml; updated .github/workflows/build.yml and release.yml to use uv; added uv installation instructions to CONTRIBUTING.md.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation update only; secondary to the build tooling change.
change_trajectory: Update build system to use uv in build_packages.py, pyproject.toml, and workflow files.
Fix uv build commands syntax and update CONTRIBUTING.md.
